theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Editorial Journal aesthetic. Tactile paper, ink, and sophisticated typography.
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The application requires a sophisticated daily journal feel, avoiding standard 'SaaS' purple/blue gradients and 'Inter' fonts. Grounded, organic palettes inspire a sense of physical writing and reflection.

typography.guidelines: Avoid default font pairings. Use Cormorant Garamond for all section headers and editor titles. Use JetBrains Mono for Markdown formatting elements like #tags and @mentions to give a 'typewriter' contrast against the elegant serif.

colors.rules: No pure whites (#FFFFFF) or pure blacks (#000000) except for highest contrast needs. The interface must feel like textured paper and ink. Use 'Tinted Grey' rule. The accent colors are muted terracotta (for tags) and dried sage/moss (for mentions) to preserve the organic feel.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow the typography and content to breathe like an editorial magazine.
spacing_and_layout.desktop_grid: 3-column layout. Left Sidebar: 280px (w-72), Right Sidebar: 320px (w-80), Center: flex-1. Use a strict grid with border-r and border-l separating the columns to mimic column rules in a newspaper.
spacing_and_layout.mobile_grid: Mobile-first approach. Only Center column is visible by default. Left Sidebar moves to a Drawer/Hamburger menu. Right calendar moves to a bottom sheet or toggleable top-bar component.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Containers with borders must use p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Cardless approach. Instead of floating cards with drop-shadows, use flat surfaces with a 1px delicate border (`border-border`) and no shadow, or subtle 1px inner highlights.
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating autocomplete menus, use Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl) with a tinted background (bg-[#FAF9F6]/80 or bg-[#141514]/80) and a sharp 1px border. No muddy gray transparency.

components.editor: A clean, distraction-free central area. Inputs should be borderless and autosizing. Markdown elements should be distinct. #tags should wrap in a subtle background pill with the 'accent_tag' color. @mentions should wrap with 'accent_mention' color.
components.autocomplete_dropdown: Must use Shadcn Popover/Command component logic but heavily customized to look like a small slip of paper (flat, 1px border, backdrop-blur).
components.calendar: Shadcn Calendar component, customized to remove heavy blue selections. Selected days should be indicated by a subtle ink-colored circle. Badges for note counts should be tiny serif numbers placed in the top-right of the date cell.
components.buttons: Neumorphic 'Tactile' variants or sharp-edged flat buttons. On light mode: bg-text_primary text-background. On dark mode: bg-text_primary text-background.
components.map: Leaflet map container should be rendered in grayscale or a custom muted style to fit the organic aesthetic, rather than the bright default map tiles.

motion.guidelines: Minimalist. Fades (opacity) and slight vertical shifts (-translate-y-1). Do not use bouncy spring animations. The application is a serious tool.
motion.hover_states: Interactive elements must always explicitly change text/background color on hover to improve accessibility without relying on defaults.

icons_and_assets.library: lucide-react (default) with 1px or 1.5px stroke widths for a lighter, more delicate feel matching the serif fonts.

hero_image_url.description: Vintage journal open flatlay - Use for Login/Register split-screen hero section.

texture_image_url.description: Ink drop texture - Can be used as a very subtle, low-opacity background blend (5-10% opacity) in empty states or auth pages.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. E.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='note-editor-input'`, `data-testid='calendar-day-cell'`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts (Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts in index.css.
Configure Tailwind spacing scale and custom color palette.
Build the 3-column layout strictly for desktop, abstracting the left and right columns into collapsible UI for mobile.
Implement light/dark mode toggle using a context provider, ensuring the 'dark' class toggles root CSS variables.
Use Shadcn UI for the calendar and dropdown/autocomplete components, but override default styles to match the 'paper and ink' aesthetic.
Ensure Leaflet maps use a custom tile layer url or CSS filters (grayscale/sepia) to fit the mood.
